payload.body_you:
Home stops being the place where every unresolved problem gets stored. The repair you keep postponing. The relative everyone accommodates. The household arrangement that works because one person keeps absorbing the inconvenience. Saturn moving through your 4th house makes the private cost harder to hide.

Start with what daily life depends on. The lease. The mortgage. The room that does not work. The family agreement nobody remembers making. You do not have to solve your entire childhood in one season, but you do need a home life that does not leave you depleted before the rest of the day begins.
